Our clients made an offer to 3 candidates, separately at separate locations,
with very good salary hikes which they happily accepted and confirmed their
joining date too. They had 90 days notice period. They resigned from the
present employer on pretext of the offer received. We were in touch with them
throughout these 90 days. Shockingly, 7-10 days before joining, all 3 refused
to join our client stating different reasons. One said he got retained. The
other said his boss is not letting him go. Third said, his family is not
wanting him to join. Later we came to know that all 3 took up other counter
offer on the offer received and have joined those companies wasting 120 days
of our clients. Now my question is - Why are the companies making counter
offers to such candidates Why are most candidates loosing their morality and
modesty over money Why have candidates become insensitive towards promises
made to an employer Suggestion - Let's make a central database of such
unprofessional candidates and verify from it before making an offer. Views
welcome........
